name: Node ESM Import Extension Compliance
greenMarker: Node ESM Import Extension Compliance 100% Verified
note: Vite resolves extensionless imports; Node does not. An import that works in the browser build and throws in every gate is the exact failure this catches.

mutations.name: an import loses its .js extension
mutations.why: The bundler forgives it, so it looks fine while running the app, and then every Node-side gate that imports that module dies with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.

mutations.name: a side-effect import loses its extension
mutations.why: External audit V11. `import './x'` has no `from`, and the regex required one, so this form was never checked. Node fails on it exactly as it fails on a named import.

mutations.name: a dynamic import loses its extension
mutations.why: External audit V11. `import('./x')` is not an import statement, so the regex never saw it; the failure arrives only when that line runs, in the middle of a gate.
mutations.replace:
import { getTodayDateKey, daysBetweenKeys } from './dateKey.js';
export const __later = () => import('./dateKey');

mutations.name: an extension-less import inside a comment (control)
mutations.why: External audit V11, the other side. The regex matched import text in comments, so an explanation that quoted an old import failed the gate. A comment is not loaded by Node, so it must not fail here — the control keeps that false positive from returning.
mutations.replace:
import { getTodayDateKey, daysBetweenKeys } from './dateKey.js';
// Formerly: import { getTodayDateKey } from './dateKey';
